summary: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting first-quarter 2026 financial results via a press release and investor presentation. The filing contains no M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation activity—it is a routine earnings disclosure under Item 2.02 and 8.01. The company highlights strong operational trends, including occupancy growth and margin expansion, but no transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are discussed. This is an ordinary ongoing reporting event, not a special situation; no further action or risk-arb angle applies.
